## Definition of Ready (the human checks before moving to "Ready")

- [ ] Story is in `As a … I want … so that …` form
- [ ] At least one testable acceptance criterion
- [ ] `Size` set on the project (XS–XL)
- [ ] Self-contained (no open blocker)
- [ ] Needs no new pattern/tool/UX that isn't already decided (or that decision is raised first)
- [ ] Prioritised (Priority set)
